reply_text: @gideon.sato: your first report in #inc-vtg-hartford was at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug, when you wrote that the gate kiosks were offline at the Hartford plant. The channel shows only one thing about the guard: your 10:42 message says the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. The next guard action is in Mateo's 11:03 message, which says kiosk 1 was back and the guard checked in trailer 8836. You confirmed both lanes working at 11:07. The channel doesn't record what the guard did between 10:42 and 11:03, so the postmortem should confirm that with the guard or site.
